protocol.name: source-bound-packed-cached-decoder-h0-v15-gemm-v2
protocol.packing: original FP16 Q/K/V and gate/up weights concatenated by output column outside timing, inside official accounting span; slices explicitly contiguous
protocol.rounding: FP16 weights and seven FP32-accumulating projections with FP16 outputs; attention output FP16 before output projection; residuals FP16
protocol.strong_baseline_policy: minimum of all six qualified library latencies including identically packed projections within each paired round; missing baseline forbids victory

timing.weight_input_policy: identical fixed input, FP16 weight bytes and immutable KV prefix

accounting.note: Includes compilation/host work; not CUDA elapsed time.

independent_consistency_scope: Read-only original sources/samples and actual official Queue; not fresh GPU reproduction.
limits: Fixed random weights; no pretrained text quality or model claim.
Application evidence cannot promote the primary AGH series.
Repeated fixed weights may fit cache; all paired raw samples retained.
Any missing predeclared library baseline forbids a strong-baseline victory.
